summary: The Form 8-K reports entry into a second amending agreement to a credit facility. Canadian Pacific Railway Company (borrower) and Canadian Pacific Kansas City Limited (covenantor) extended the 5-year maturity from June 25, 2030 to June 25, 2031 and the 2-year maturity from June 25, 2027 to June 25, 2028. No price, premium, board recommendation, or structural changes beyond maturity extensions. This is a routine credit agreement amendment, not a special situation. No risk-arb angle or regulatory clock triggered.
